change.description: Fall back legacy wm-a-v1 and wm-b-v1 public media URLs to their canonical base assets when release packaging encounters a 404, while recording aliases for verification.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: This is a backward-compatible release packaging reliability fix. It preserves the public media facade and only changes how legacy derived URLs are frozen when their origin representation is unavailable.

current.reasoning: The packager now retries the canonical base asset only after a derived 404, preserves URL version parameters, and keeps one canonical packaged file with verifiable aliases; successful derived assets retain their existing path identity.

evidence.command: The verifier validates canonical alias identity and excludes aliases from packaged counters
